items.title: feat(xmlui): Card module owns client card membership
items.description:
One client module, **Card**, owns card membership: grouping stored listings into cards, the member event ids behind each card, which cards are picked, the representative pick per card, and the delete plan a pick or unpick executes. Pure functions attached to `window`, loaded as a shipped script before the helpers script and before app start.

Card reads only the stored route decision (`duplicate_group`, `merged_ids`, `source_names`, `source_urls`) and never recomputes similarity — the build-time confidence route stays the sole authority on which listings are one event (ADR-0013). A NULL `duplicate_group` means one row is one card.

Deliver the full interface: `group`, `groupMemo`, `members`, `isPicked`, `uniquePicks`, `pickPlan`, `cardForPick`, `normalizePick`.

The load-bearing job is **enrichment folding**: a virtual occurrence whose original-occurrence flag is set attaches to its linked group's card (enrichment data arrives on a separate fetch from events); every other virtual occurrence stays its own card, marked virtual, and synthetic enrichment ids never enter membership. The legacy raw-row fallback (split the comma-joined `source` string, then apply the aggregator/location ordering) is kept so vm fixtures over raw rows stay meaningful, though it is inert on view rows. Memoisation uses the existing composite signature (array signature + enrichment-linkage signature + emission signature), with a reset hook for the vm harness.
items.notes: Delivered xmlui/card.js exposing group, groupMemo, members, isPicked, uniquePicks, pickPlan, cardForPick, normalizePick, resetMemo as pure window functions. Injected before helpers.js via the shell.js loader list, xmlui/test.html, and tests/js/load-shipped.js. Grouping reads only the view's duplicate_group/merged_ids/source_names/source_urls; a NULL group is its own card; an enrichment original folds onto its linked card, while other virtual occurrences stay separate with isVirtual and empty membership. Ordering pins grouped-before-Separate then group-id/title. Tests in tests/js/card-membership.test.js (35) cover the public interface with hand-computed literals, the enrichment_fold fixture fold-to-group output (9 pre-collapse cards; collapse deliberately left to item 03), the production fixture pass-through equivalence (3795 cards, memberships intact), and uniquePicks ranking cross-checked against my-picks/dedupe.ts. New scripts/bench_card_group.js wired into pnpm bench verifies the warm memo hit. Decisions: Card.group keeps the legacy raw-row aggregator/location ordering (reads source_priority.json lazily) per the ticket; Card emits merged_ids only, dropping the camelCase mergedIds alias ahead of item 04. Checks green: make lint, make test-python (357), make test-node (289), make test-deno (5), pnpm bench, Playwright test-html spec.

items.title: feat(xmlui): Recurring owns the weekly collapse, applied once
items.description:
A second small module, **Recurring**, owns the long-running-series weekly collapse — first occurrence per week, the five-occurrence minimum, and the `isRecurring` mark — as a pure function with an injected clock. Its rule is otherwise unchanged; only its ownership and placement change.

Extract it from the grouping path and apply it **once**, at its current composition point (after exclusions and source ordering, before hidden-source filtering and the search index). The second application is removed, and the sources dialog calls it explicitly.

Intended delta: the enrichment path now follows the plain path's rule in the excluded-source edge case — a Separate-band pair sharing title/location/time-of-day whose collapse survivor comes from an excluded source is kept by both paths, where today they disagree.
items.notes: Extracted the weekly collapse into xmlui/recurring.js, exposing window.Recurring.collapse(events, { now }) as a pure rule (first occurrence per week, five-occurrence minimum, isRecurring mark, injected Date|ms|ISO clock). Removed the collapse call from dedupeEvents; helpers.js's collapseLongRunningEvents now owns only the pipeline-level content-key cache and delegates the rule to Recurring, so the collapse runs exactly once at the processEvents composition point (after filterExternalExclusions + sortSourcesForDisplay, before filterHiddenSources + buildSearchIndex). SourcesDialog wraps its grouped rows in window.Recurring.collapse explicitly in both bindings. Loader order updated in shell.js, xmlui/test.html, tests/js/load-shipped.js, and scripts/bench_collapse_long.js. New tests/js/recurring-collapse.test.js (12) covers the five-occurrence minimum, per-week selection, the injected-clock week-anchor shift, pass-through below the minimum, empty input, dedupeEvents no longer collapsing, exactly-once Recurring.collapse on the enrichment path, the pinned stage order, collapse-before-hidden-filter, the excluded-source intended delta (both paths now keep the non-excluded week), and the dialog call site. Intended behavior change recorded in spec.md Intended Behavior Changes #1; ADR-0017 and the acceptance checklist land in item 09. Decisions: the rule module stays pure so no Recurring memo reset is needed; clearDedupeCache still resets the pipeline cache; no opts.timeZone added (the test harness points the city at the machine zone for deterministic time-of-day). Checks green: make lint, make test (357 python + 303 node + 5 deno), make test-browser (25), pnpm bench.

items.title: refactor(xmlui): calendar list and event card read one membership
items.description:
The calendar's grouping and the card's bookmark read the one membership module. A pick made on one source's row lights up the duplicate card rendered from another source, and unpicking clears it everywhere.

Drop the camelCase `mergedIds` alias in favour of the view's `merged_ids`; `members` is the reader. The card's bookmark reads `isPicked`, which returns false for virtual cards, and the icon is hidden on virtual (future-occurrence) cards — today it renders on every signed-in card and its save always fails on the picks foreign key.
items.notes: Calendar enrichment-path grouping now folds through window.Card.groupMemo instead of dedupeEvents (combineEvents keeps its linked-enrichment guard; the plain path still passes view rows through), so processed cards carry only merged_ids plus isVirtual for unfolded future occurrences. EventCard's bookmark reads window.Card.isPicked and is hidden on virtual cards via a when guard. eventMergedIds now delegates to window.Card.members (members is the reader) for togglePick, and dedupeEvents' legacy output field is renamed mergedIds -> merged_ids (test.html pins re-pointed) so merged_ids is the only member field; the camelCase alias survives only in Card's sanctioned raw-row fallback. Fixed a Card.group bug the ported two-row assertion exposed: the unioned source_urls never reached the emitted card (g.row kept the first row's map), so a second member's source link was lost; Card.group now emits the tracked union and card-membership.test.js pins it. clearDedupeCache now resets Card.groupMemo so same-shaped fixtures cannot false-HIT across cases. All 37 issue-153 assertions were ported to the Card seam, not rewritten; the EventCard call-site check pins window.Card.isPicked + the isVirtual guard (markup glue has no browser harness; item 08 formalizes call-site checks). Decisions: dedupeEvents/eventMergedIds/dedupePicks stay for items 07/08 to delete; SourcesDialog still groups through dedupeEvents until item 07 (delegating it to Card now would lose its cache before item 07 adds the strong-signature memo). Checks green: make lint, make test-python (357), make test-node (304), make test-deno (5), make test-browser (25), pnpm bench.

items.title: refactor(xmlui): picks list collapses through Card.uniquePicks
items.description: My Picks shows one entry per stored event, using `Card.uniquePicks` over whole pick objects (the list item passes the pick, not just its id). The representative ranking stays exactly the same as the client twin and the `my-picks` ICS feed — representative first, then smallest `event_id` — so the list and the feed cannot pick different members (ADR-0013). A saved pick survives a build that reshuffles which listing represents the group.
items.notes: My Picks now reads window.Card.uniquePicks for both the count and the List data bindings in Main.xmlui, replacing the legacy window.dedupePicks call sites (the list is the last consumer of that seam; the function itself stays defined for item 08 to delete, and the legacy dedupePicks unit block in validate-dedupe-groups.test.js stays green against it until then). PickItem already received the whole pick object ($props.pick.*, pick="{$item}"), so criterion 4 needed only a pin. Re-pointed the source-text call-site check to window.Card.uniquePicks(picks.value plus a negative assertion that no window.dedupePicks remains, and added a check that the List hands PickItem the whole item (pick="{$item}") because uniquePicks ranks on the pick's fetched event fields (representative, event_id) a bare id would drop. Behavioral coverage lives at the Card seam already: card-membership.test.js tests one-entry-per-group, the representative/smallest-id ranking, the build-reshuffle fallback, and the cross-check against my-picks/dedupe.ts (imported, ADR-0013). No memo added to uniquePicks — the spec interface lists it without one and picks change wholesale on refetch. Checks green: make lint (type checkers + prettier + eslint), make test-python (357), make test-node (305), make test-deno (5), make test-browser (25), pnpm bench.

items.title: refactor(xmlui): one write authority for pick and unpick
items.description:
The two write paths — `togglePick` and `removePick` — become one authority whose delete plan comes from `Card.pickPlan`. The plan carries a single member-id list; the authority issues two deletes: picks by `event_id in members` and `user_id`, and enrichments by `event_id in members` and `curator_id`. User/curator scoping stays verbatim on every URL; RLS remains the backstop, not the primary scoping.

`removePick` resolves its card from a new App global that mirrors the processed card list (same listener pattern as the picks data). Because that mirror is city-and-window scoped, on a miss it falls back to DB-side resolution: if the pick carries a `duplicate_group`, one `events?duplicate_group=eq.<group>` GET yields the full membership; for NULL-group or orphaned picks, membership is the pick row's own `event_id`. Then the same two deletes run.

Bookmarking or unbookmarking must not re-ingest the whole event list.
items.notes: Both write paths now route through one code-behind authority, runPickPlan(card, headers), whose member list comes from window.Card.pickPlan(card).memberEventIds; it issues the same two user-scoped deletes — picks by event_id=in.(members)&user_id=eq.<user>, enrichments by event_id=in.(members)&curator_id=eq.<user> — so unpicking now also clears the curator's enrichment for the group (intended, story 6). togglePick's GET-existing probe stays outside the module and the one-click POST still sends event.id unchanged; its membership read moved from eventMergedIds to Card.members. removePick now takes the whole pick object (PickItem: removePick($props.pick)) and resolves membership from a new App global processedCards (mirrors dateFilteredEvents via the same ChangeListener pattern as picksData); on a miss it falls back to one GET events?select=id&duplicate_group=eq.<group> (collecting member ids) or the pick's own event_id for a NULL group / orphan. A members-length guard keeps a virtual mirror match from silently swallowing the removal. A picks change still only refetches picks+enrichments (no refetchEvents/ingest), pinned. New tests/js/pick-write-authority.test.js (11) pins the glue call sites (the vm harness cannot load code-behind); validate-dedupe-groups.test.js's old removePick call-site check was re-pointed to the new routing. Decisions: no new Card interface (the plan stays Card.pickPlan; the executor is engine-bound glue); the DB group GET returns each member row's id (events has no merged_ids), so membership = rows.map(id); the mirror is dateFilteredEvents because the spec requires a window-scoped mirror, which is exactly why the DB fallback exists. Checks green: make lint, make test (357 python + 316 node + 5 deno), make test-browser (25), pnpm bench.

items.title: refactor(xmlui): sources dialog and dashboard tiles apply the same rule
items.description:
The sources dialog and the dashboard tiles apply the same grouping rule as the list.

- The sources dialog lifts grouping to a named step: `Card.group` plus an explicit `Recurring.collapse` over its current city-filtered rows, then hidden-source filtering with its uncommitted `localHidden` preview. It deliberately keeps its own filter inputs (no date window), so its counts are not expected to equal the list's row count — what changes is the rule, not the inputs. Hiding a source hides every card it fully carries.
- The dashboard tiles apply `Card.group` and `Recurring.collapse` **before** category/search filtering, the same order as the list. Tiles do no client collapse today, so tile counts drop for long-running series — intended.
items.notes: SourcesDialog groups through window.Card.groupMemo(currentEvents, window.eventsSignature(currentEvents)) and applies window.Recurring.collapse once in a new named var groupedEvents; both count bindings (header total via filterHiddenSources, per-source table via getVisibleSourceCounts) read it, so the rule runs once and no longer through dedupeEvents. The dialog keeps its own inputs (city filter, uncommitted localHidden, no date window). Dashboard tiles: window.filterTileEvents now groups+collapses tile rows (Card.groupMemo(events, eventsSignature(events)) then Recurring.collapse) before the tile's category/search filter, mirroring the list's order; FeedTile documents the limit=200 truncation caveat. New tests/js/dialog-and-tiles.test.js (8): call-site checks for the dialog's named step and inputs; hiding a source hides every card it fully carries (a grouped [A,B] card survives hiding A, drops when A+B are hidden); collapse runs before the dialog's hidden filter (DST-bounded count); tile collapse drops series rows; tile category/search filter the collapsed cards not raw members (a term on a collapsed-away same-week occurrence finds nothing); a member row folds onto its card before searching. Re-pointed recurring-collapse.test.js's dialog assertion from two collapse(dedupeEvents(...)) bindings to the one named Card.groupMemo step. Decisions: used groupMemo with the strong eventsSignature per the spec's memoisation note (dialog/tiles already hold a signature) rather than plain Card.group; grouping+collapse live inside filterTileEvents so the tile's real pipeline is behaviorally testable rather than re-created in a test. Checks green: make lint (type checkers + prettier + eslint), make test-python (357), make test-node (324), make test-deno (5), make test-browser (25), pnpm bench.

items.title: chore(xmlui): retire the dead toggle and legacy membership names
items.description:
The contract step of the refactor: with every consumer migrated, remove the legacy membership surface and the dead code, and re-point the tests that pinned it.

- Delete the dead `window.togglePick` in `shell.js` — a second toggle keyed on a bare event id, referenced by no markup.
- Remove `dedupeEvents`, `eventMergedIds`, and `dedupePicks` outright, migrating every call site to the module.
- Retire the source-text regex assertions that only pinned the old call sites, and replace them with **call-site checks** for the code-behind glue (the pick/unpick routing), which no automated test covers today because the vm harness does not load code-behind.
items.notes: Retired the legacy membership surface now that every consumer reads Card. Deleted the dead window.togglePick from shell.js (a second toggle keyed on a bare event id, referenced by no markup; EventCard still calls the Globals.xs code-behind togglePick). Removed dedupeEvents (plus its _dedupedEvents* cache vars and window wrapper), eventMergedIds, and dedupePicks (plus its identity cache and window exports) from helpers.js outright; clearDedupeCache dropped the dead _dedupedEvents resets so its comments now describe the collapse stage only. Migrated every call site: recurring-collapse.test.js's 'groups but no longer collapses' case now drives Card.group (the grouping authority), the legacy dedupePicks block in validate-dedupe-groups.test.js now asserts Card.uniquePicks over the same hand-computed picks, and test.html's dedupeEvents describes/real-data tests now call window.Card.group (16 call sites; describes renamed). Retired the now-vacuous source-text negatives (SourcesDialog/Main.xmlui not.toContain('dedupeEvents'/'window.dedupePicks')) since Card is the sole authority and the window globals are gone. New tests/js/legacy-membership-retired.test.js (2) pins the contract: window.dedupeEvents/eventMergedIds/dedupePicks are undefined after the shipped scripts load, and shell.js no longer defines window.togglePick while the live Globals.xs togglePick + EventCard call site stay. The pick/unpick routing call-site checks already live in pick-write-authority.test.js (11, unchanged) and remain the code-behind glue coverage the vm harness cannot load. Decisions: re-pointed rather than deleted the ported issue-153 assertions so the behavior stays pinned at the module seam; left stale prose in docs/deduplication.md, docs/recurrence.md, docs/search-and-performance.md, and docs/performance-investigation*.md for the docs item (09) since prose is not a call site. Checks green: make lint (ruff + 4 type checkers + prettier + eslint), make test-python (357), pnpm vitest run (326 across 13 files), make test-deno (5), pnpm playwright test (25), pnpm bench.

items.title: docs(xmlui): Card glossary entry, ADR-0017, and acceptance checklist
items.description:
Commit the documentation on the feature branch (never on `main`) and record the verification evidence.

- Add the **Card** entry to the domain glossary.
- Add **ADR-0017** — "client card membership is one module" — referencing ADR-0013.
- Record the before/after performance capture with a tolerance.
- Add the acceptance checklist mapping all 24 stories to their verification.
items.notes: Docs-only commit on the feature branch (feat/169-card-membership; nothing written to main). Added the Card glossary entry to CONTEXT.md (after Listing, cross-linked to ADR-0017) and docs/adr/0017-client-card-membership-is-one-module.md (Status accepted; Context/Decision/Consequences/Alternatives per the ADR README; references ADR-0013 by relative link). Added docs/card-membership-verification.md holding the before/after performance capture and the 24-story acceptance checklist (mirrors the docs/date-tabs-a11y-checklist.md precedent for a human/verification gate). Perf capture (Apple silicon macOS, Node v26.7.0): (a) durable `pnpm bench` gates, medians of 5 — bench_collapse_long cold 57.1ms (before) / 56.3ms (after), warm 0.1ms both; bench_card_group (new guard) cold 78.4ms synthetic / 100.2ms over the captured 3,795-row view payload, warm 0.2–0.3ms; (b) ad-hoc equivalent full transform (group+collapse) over tests/fixtures/deduplicated_events_bloomington.json.gz, 10 reps after 3 warm-ups, 3 interleaved runs — cold 445–526ms before vs 431–500ms after (0.89–0.97×), warm 59–70ms vs 50–60ms (0.84–0.87×). Tolerance set at +15% cold and the benchmarks' 5ms warm-hit threshold; both hold, no regression. Decision (unattended run, pre-approved): 'before' is the branch start 0dfcfc43e, whose xmlui/ is byte-identical to origin/main at the merge-base c35ac2411 (the fixtures commit adds only test fixtures) — verified with git diff; recorded that in the doc so the baseline is reproducible. No source code changed (docs only), so no new durable test was warranted beyond the existing seam tests; the checklist maps each story to the test/bench that already pins it. Checks green: make lint (ruff + 4 type checkers + prettier + eslint), make test-python (357), make test-node (326), make test-deno (5), pnpm bench.

items.title: Review the work against the spec
items.description: Run `code-review` over `git diff 0dfcfc43ed3a2fe50dbf182f33bf77a17de17bf9...HEAD` against the spec at `.scratch/169-card-membership/spec.md`. Run the findings through `receiving-code-review`. Append each worthwhile finding as a new item with no `reference` and `hand_off: false`, with a `priority` greater than this item's. Write every remaining finding and every outstanding hand-off item into this item's `notes`.
items.notes: Ran code-review over `git diff 0dfcfc43ed3a2fe50dbf182f33bf77a17de17bf9...HEAD` (9 commits, 25 files) against `.scratch/169-card-membership/spec.md`: two parallel axes (Standards, Spec), then every finding run through receiving-code-review and re-verified against the code before recording. Three findings were worth a later fix and became items 11-13 (priorities 10-12), each with no `reference` and `hand_off: false`: (p10) Card/Recurring fork helpers.js's source-name/aggregator-ordering/timezone helpers; (p11) the legacy pick read `isEventPicked` and the camelCase `mergedIds` input reads survive with no production caller; (p12) the production-fixture equivalence test is structural only (card count + members), not the full-row golden the spec asks for. Remaining findings, held (none is a hard standard breach; each is a judgement call): Recurring exposes no memo reset — defensible, it is stateless, only Card holds memo state, no action. Recurring exports `MIN_OCCURRENCES` beyond the pinned interface (spec line 62) and nothing consumes it — minor scope creep, drop it alongside the item-12 cleanup or leave it as a named constant. `pickPlan` is a one-line delegation to `members` — rejected: spec line 70 pins `pickPlan(card) -> { memberEventIds }`, so the wrapper is the contract, not a Middle Man. `removePick`'s DB fallback hand-assembles Card's own shape at the call site (`runPickPlan({ id, merged_ids: members })`, Globals.xs:347/350) — minor Feature Envy/Primitive Obsession; a `Card.pickPlanForMemberIds(ids)` would move that knowledge back into Card, left un-itemised as low value. `Card.groupMemo` is a single shared slot, so the calendar's `combineEvents` fold, SourcesDialog, and each tile evict one another even though dialog/tiles pass the strong `window.eventsSignature` — output is correct and pnpm bench passes (warm hit verified), but the spec's signature-keying only partly delivers cross-site reuse; recorded as low-severity. Process oddity: `prd.json` is committed at the repo root while its `.scratch/*` references are gitignored — no documented rule forbids it, but it ships an agent working artifact; consider dropping before the PR. Outstanding hand-off items: none (no item carries `hand_off: true`). Decisions (unattended loop, pre-approved): recorded the worthwhile findings as separate backlog items rather than fixing them inside the review item, because the item's charge is review-and-append and the new items are the fix queue; verified each finding against the code first, and rejected the two that the spec itself pins. Checks: `make lint` and `make test` green (review was a prd-only change; no source touched).

items.title: refactor(xmlui): share source-name, ordering, and timezone helpers
items.description: Card and Recurring fork helpers.js's source helpers instead of reading one derivation. `card.js` re-implements `uniqueSourceNames`, `eventSourceNames`, `normalizeVenueToken`, `sourceMatchesLocation`, and the aggregator/location ordering (`orderSourceNames` duplicating `sortSourcesForDisplay`); `recurring.js`'s `cityTimezone` duplicates `getCityTimezone`. The spec (line 68) says ordering "stays the separate `sortSourcesForDisplay` helper, so Card takes no aggregator dependency", while line 66 requires the raw-row fallback ordering inside Card — the two clauses contradict, and the implementation resolved it by forking. Also dedupe the intra-Card pairs: `seedMemberIds`/`members`, and the `'g:'+duplicate_group : 'r:'+id` key rebuilt in `routeGroupKey` and `uniquePicks`. Constraint: `card.js` is loaded standalone by `scripts/bench_card_group.js` (and before helpers.js at runtime), so share via a small standalone module or update that bench to load helpers.js too.
items.notes: Delivered the standalone shared module `xmlui/source-helpers.js` exposing `window.SourceHelpers` with the one derivation of the source helpers: `uniqueSourceNames`, `eventSourceNames`, `orderSourceNames` (the aggregator/location ordering), and `cityTimezone`; venue normalisation/matching are private internals (public surface kept to what the three consumers need). helpers.js's `eventSourceNames` and `getCityTimezone` are now thin named delegates (getCityTimezone keeps its many in-file callers and the validate-date-tabs source-text pin), `sortSourcesForDisplay` splits with `SourceHelpers.uniqueSourceNames` and orders with `SourceHelpers.orderSourceNames`, and helpers.js's forked `uniqueSourceNames`/`normalizeVenueToken`/`sourceMatchesLocation` were deleted. card.js dropped its five forked helpers and reads `window.SourceHelpers.eventSourceNames`/`orderSourceNames`; recurring.js dropped `cityTimezone` and reads `window.SourceHelpers.cityTimezone`. Intra-Card dedupe: added `memberIdList(row)` as the single reader behind `seedMemberIds`/`members`, and `routeKey(duplicateGroup, id)` behind `routeGroupKey` and `uniquePicks`. Loader order updated: shell.js (source-helpers before card), xmlui/test.html, tests/js/load-shipped.js, scripts/bench_card_group.js, scripts/bench_collapse_long.js; docs/card-membership-verification.md's harness description updated. New tests/js/source-helpers.test.js (9): SourceHelpers behaviour with hand-computed literals (split/dedupe, structured-over-comma, aggregators-last + location promotion, city timezone), delegation spies proving Card.group, helpers sortSourcesForDisplay, and Recurring.collapse read SourceHelpers, and a structural pin that Card/Recurring keep no forked copy. Decisions: a standalone module (the ticket's first option) over loading helpers.js into the bench, since helpers.js needs window._categories/DOM-adjacent state and the bench wants only the pure derivation; the raw-row ordering stays lazily cached by the `_sourcePriority` array identity so the card-membership test that swaps `_sourcePriority` still recomputes. Checks green: make lint (ruff + 4 type checkers + prettier + eslint), make test-python (357), make test-node (335), make test-deno (5), make test-browser (25), pnpm bench.

items.title: chore(xmlui): retire the surviving legacy pick read and alias
items.description: `isEventPicked` (helpers.js:1482) is still defined and exported (`window.isEventPicked`, helpers.js:2510) and exercised only by its own `xmlui/test.html` block — no production call site remains, so it is a second pick-state reader kept alive by its test (spec Solution: one place decides `isPicked`; spec line 79 removed only `dedupeEvents`/`eventMergedIds`/`dedupePicks`). Delete it and re-point or retire the test.html block to `Card.isPicked`. Also drop the vestigial camelCase `mergedIds` input reads in `card.js` (`seedMemberIds` line 140, `members` lines 257-258): the only producer (`dedupeEvents`) was deleted, so those reads can never fire (spec line 78: drop the alias in favour of `merged_ids`).
items.notes: Retired the last surviving legacy pick read and the retired membership alias so Card.isPicked + the view's merged_ids are the only membership surface. Deleted isEventPicked (definition helpers.js and its window export) — grepped the tree: no production call site remained, only the old test.html block. Re-pointed that browser block to Card.isPicked (null picks, any-member match, no-match, false-for-virtual, single-id fallback), keeping the same edges the legacy reader covered but against the one reader; the vitest seam (card-membership.test.js Card.isPicked, 4 cases) already covers the semantics, so this is the browser page staying in sync rather than new coverage. Dropped the camelCase mergedIds fallback in Card.memberIdList (the single read behind seedMemberIds/members); its only producer, dedupeEvents, was deleted in item 08, so a row carrying only the alias is now correctly a NULL-group row that falls back to its own id. Tests first: added expect(window.isEventPicked).toBeUndefined() to legacy-membership-retired.test.js and a Card.members case that a mergedIds-only row returns [id] (both red before the change, green after). Decisions: re-pointed rather than deleted the test.html block so the browser group still exercises pick-reading; dropped the alias read rather than keeping a dormant branch because the producer is gone and spec line 78 says merged_ids is the one key. No docs referenced isEventPicked (only the spec's historical prose), so nothing else to re-point. Checks green: make lint (ruff + 4 type checkers + prettier + eslint), make test-python (357), make test-node (337), make test-deno (5), make test-browser (25), pnpm bench (collapse-long + Card.groupMemo warm hits verified).

items.title: test(xmlui): full-row equivalence over the production view payload
items.description: The captured production-payload test (tests/js/card-membership.test.js:547-567) asserts only card count and per-card `members()` equality — a silently dropped or reordered field (`source`, `source_names`, `source_urls`, `isVirtual`, start-time ordering) would still pass. The spec's Testing Decisions and Further Notes call for "output equals the golden snapshot". Strengthen the test to compare the grouped output field-for-field against a committed golden (or against the input rows, given the plain path is near pass-through), so story 21's output-equivalence claim is actually verified.
